The 74LS165 is an 8-bit parallel-in/serial-out shift register commonly used in digital circuits for expanding input lines or facilitating serial data communication. Below are its key specifications:
Parallel Data Loading: Allows simultaneous loading of 8-bit data through individual inputs when the shift/load (SH/LD) control input is low.
Serial Data Shifting: Shifts data towards the serial output (QH) on each clock pulse when SH/LD is high.
Gated Clock Inputs: Includes clock (CLK) and clock inhibit (CLK INH) inputs; clocking occurs only when CLK INH is low.
Complementary Outputs: Provides both true (QH) and complementary (QH’) outputs from the eighth bit.

These features make the 74LS165 suitable for applications requiring parallel-to-serial data conversion, such as expanding microcontroller input ports or interfacing with serial communication protocols.

The MCP23017 device provides 16-bit, general purpose parallel I/O expansion for I2C bus applications. The MCP23X17 consists of multiple 8-bit configuration registers for input, output and polarity selection. The system master can enable the I/Os as either inputs or outputs by writing the I/O configuration bits (IODIRA/B). The data for each input or output is kept in the corresponding input or output register. The polarity of the Input Port register can be inverted with the Polarity Inversion register. All registers can be read by the system master.

The 16-bit I/O port functionally consists of two 8-bit ports (PORTA and PORTB). The MCP23X17 can be configured to operate in the 8-bit or 16-bit modes via IOCON.BANK. There are two interrupt pins, INTA and INTB, that can be associated with their respective ports, or can be logically OR’ed together so that both pins will activate if either port causes an interrupt. The interrupt output can be configured to activate under two conditions (mutually exclusive):
1. When any input state differs from its corresponding Input Port register state. This is used to indicate to the system master that an input state has changed.
2. When an input state differs from a preconfigured register value (DEFVAL register).

The Interrupt Capture register captures port values at the time of the interrupt, thereby saving the condition that caused the interrupt. The Power-on Reset (POR) sets the registers to their default values and initializes the device state machine. The hardware address pins are used to determine the device address.

Crystal Oscillator 2Pin HC-49S 455KHZ provides both series and parallel resonance. The series resonance is a few kilohertz lower than the parallel one. Crystals below 30 MHz are generally operated between series and parallel resonance, which means that the crystal appears as an inductive reactance in operation, this inductance forming a parallel resonant circuit with externally connected parallel capacitance. Any small additional capacitance in parallel with the crystal will thus pull the frequency downwards. Moreover, the effective inductive reactance of the crystal can be reduced by adding a capacitor in series with the crystal. This latter technique can provide a useful method of trimming the oscillatory frequency within a narrow range; in this case inserting a capacitor in series with the crystal will raise the frequency of oscillation. For a crystal to operate at its specified frequency, the electronic circuit has to be exactly that specified by the crystal manufacturer. Note that these points imply a subtlety concerning crystal oscillators in this frequency range: the crystal does not usually oscillate at precisely either of its resonant frequencies.

A crystal oscillator is an electronic oscillator circuit that uses the mechanical resonance of a vibrating crystal of piezoelectric material to create an electrical signal with a very precise frequency.

The CN3083 is a complete constant-current /constant voltage linear charger for single cell Li-ion and Li Polymer rechargeable batteries. The device contains an on-chip power MOSFET and eliminates the need for the external sense resistor and blocking diode. An on-chip 8-bit ADC can adjust charging current automatically based on the output capability of input power supply, so CN3083 is ideally suited for solar powered system. Furthermore, the CN3083 is specifically designed to work within USB power specifications. Thermal feedback regulates the charge current to limit the die temperature during high power operation or high ambient temperature. The regulation voltage is internally fixed at 4.2V with 1% accuracy, it can also be adjusted with an external resistor. The charge current can be programmed externally with a single resistor. When the input supply is removed, the CN3083 automatically enters a low power sleep mode , dropping the battery drain current to less than 3uA. Other features include undervoltage lockout, automatic recharge, battery temperature sensing and charging/termination indicator. The CN3083 is available in a thermally enhanced 8-pin SOP package.

So you’d like to dip your toe into e-textiles, but you’re not sure what this conductive thread is all about. Not a problem! It’s really not more difficult than other types of sewing, so with a quick tutorial you should be ready to get started.
If you’d like some background information, there are a couple of tutorials that might be helpful:

Conductive thread can carry current the same way that wires can, which means it can be used to create a circuit. This allows the user to sew a circuit together, creating flexible circuits that require no soldering. In some textile-based projects, this is the most practical tool to maintain the hang of the fabric. Educationally, it’s a very safe and unintimidating way to learn how to use embedded electronics.

SparkFun currently sells silver and stainless steel threads. Beyond our selection of conductive threads, there exists a staggering number of conductive materials. If it’s electrically conductive (you can check this with a multimeter), and you can sew with it (this includes hand and machine, sewing and embroidery, crocheting, knitting, all sorts of things, really), I encourage you to consider it a conductive thread. Some traditional embroidery threads have enough metal content to be conductive, and some wires are fine enough to sew with. If you keep an open mind (and a multimeter close at hand!), quite a few materials can find new life in your projects!
How Do I Choose the Best Conductive Thread For My Project?
There are many types of conductive thread, but in the interest of brevity, I’m going to focus on the ones SparkFun carries; they fit into two categories.

First, we have silver-coated threads. These are nylon thread, like you’ve seen before, but they’ve been coated with silver, which is conductive. The resistance of silver threads can vary a great deal. If your project is large (think a quilt, or a circuit that spans an entire full-length dress), make sure you check the resistance of the thread you are considering against the needs of your circuit. If your project is small (a painting canvas, a t-shirt, anything where the traces won’t go more than a couple of feet) and the acceptable resistance is high, silver is great! Our finest, easiest to use thread is the 2-ply silver, which is hand sewable and useable as a top and bobbin thread in most sewing machines. Because the base of these silver threads is nylon, they’re completely incompatible with soldering. The nylon interior of the thread is just too susceptible to heat; it can’t take the temperature necessary to melt solder.

Second, we have stainless steel threads, which are a little bit different. There is no traditional thread core; these threads are made entirely of stainless steel. They’re a little bit more difficult to sew with because they can be a bit ‘twisty’, but they make up for it with very reliable (and low) resistance. If you’ve got a project in mind that requires very long traces (more than a few feet), you’ll need low resistance. Currently, our lowest resistance threads are all stainless, so that’s where you’ll want to start. The lowest resistance threads are VERY thick, more like twine than thread, and can’t really be stitched. These are great to use in casings, piping, or stitched down with embroidery or a machine zig-zig stitch.

Because these threads are composed entirely of stainless steel, they’re much more soldering-friendly. The heat of a soldering iron won’t damage the thread (although it will discolor it a bit, so be warned), so you can solder on, near, or to the thread. Do be aware that stainless steel is not an easy material to solder to, so you’ve still got a tough job ahead if you want to solder something directly to the thread.

Choosing the correct thread is very project-specific. Your safest bet on a complicated project is to calculate the resistance your circuit can handle using Ohm’s Law. Divide that resistance by the feet of distance you anticipate between your power supply and components, and look for the thinnest thread of that resistance or less. If that all sounds a little bit complicated, don’t worry. You can use trial and error to get a feel for which threads work best for you, and most projects don’t require the lowest resistance available. The stainless steel bobbin is an excellent starting point. It’s useable by hand or in a sewing machine and relatively low resistance (about 28 ohms per foot.) It’s also cheap, so it’s a small commitment. If you DO find that your resistance is too high, it’s not a hard fix. Every time you add another strand of the same thread to the trace, you halve the resistance. If you don’t want to remove and replace the traces, you can pass back over them to bring the resistance down to an acceptable level.
How Do I Sew with Conductive Thread?

You won’t need any special equipment to sew with conductive thread- regular needles, scissors, etc. will be fine. There are, however, a few things you need to know about the texture of the thread. The ends can fray easily. If you find yourself having trouble, beeswax can help. The thread is also entirely uninsulated. That means that it isn’t coated with a non-conductive material, and if two strands touch one another, they’ll conduct between them. When you design your project, you’ll have to try and prevent threads carrying individual signal from touching each other. If you need to cross traces, you’ll have to add an insulating layer.

Thick fabric, fabric paint, electrical tape, or any other highly resistive material that is compatible with your project should work. When two traces that aren’t supposed to touch do, and current flows through them, it’s called a short circuit, or a short. A short circuit will prevent your circuit from working, and more importantly, can be dangerous. It allows the battery to release energy very quickly, which can cause heat, smoke, sparks, or scorching. The amount of potential damage depends on your power supply, but be careful!

blocks.text: 7818 IC – +18 V Fixed Linear Voltage Regulator (78xx series)

The 7818 IC is a three-terminal positive +18 V fixed linear regulator from the well-known 78xx family. It provides a stable 18 V rail with integrated current limiting, thermal shutdown, and safe-operating-area protection, making it a dependable choice for analog rails, on-board regulation, and repair of legacy equipment that expects the standard 78xx pinout and behavior.
✅ Simple, predictable regulation — fixed +18 V output with minimal external parts for quick, repeatable designs.
🛡️ Built-in protections — current limit and thermal shutdown help safeguard the regulator and downstream circuitry.
🔌 Low parts count — typical application uses just two bypass capacitors (input and output).
🧩 Standard pinout — 78xx convention (IN – GND – OUT) supports drop-in replacement in many existing boards.
🎚️ Quiet analog rail — linear topology is favored where low switching noise is a priority.
✅ Instrumentation and test fixtures needing a clean +18 V analog supply.
✅ On-card post-regulation to isolate a sensitive block from upstream ripple.
✅ Education, kits, and repair work for equipment designed around 78xx regulators.
✅ Audio, control, and sensor interfaces that prefer low-noise linear rails.
✅ Headroom: ensure the input voltage stays a few volts above 18 V (design margin so VIN remains ≥ ~20 V at the ripple trough) to maintain regulation.

✅ Bypass capacitors: place a small capacitor close to IN (e.g., ~0.33 µF) and another at OUT (e.g., ~0.1 µF) to enhance stability and transient response; larger electrolytics may be added per your layout and load.
✅ Thermal budget: estimate dissipation PD ≈ (VIN − 18 V) × IOUT; size the heatsink/copper area to keep the junction within safe limits.
✅ Reverse conditions: if the output can be driven when the input is off (or if large output capacitors are used), add protective diodes as per standard 78xx practices.
✅ Load current: treat ~1 A as the typical continuous capability for common through-hole versions with suitable heatsinking; always confirm against the exact device and package you will stock.
Through-hole: TO-220 (common for prototyping and power stages).
Insulated variants: TO-220FP (plastic full-pack) for easier heatsink mounting.
SMD options: D²PAK/DPAK for compact layouts.

ULN2803?is?a high-voltage and high-current Darlington transistor array and is mainly used as a relay driver with an ability?to handle 8?relays?at a time.
It comes with a collector-emitter voltage around 50 V and input voltage residing at 30 V.

Before we move further, we must know what is?Darlington transistor? It is commonly known as?Darlington pair which is nothing but a combination of two?bipolar transistors?featuring a compound?design and is connected?back to back?where current amplified by the first transistor is again amplified by the second one.

This shape delivers a much higher?current gain as compared to each transistor taken separately. It works on the simple amplification principle happening in the regular transistor where a small base is used to make the pair switch for higher switching currents.
This?Darlington transistor mainly operates at 5V? and is based on TTL (Transistor-Transistor Logic) and CMOS (Complementary Metal Oxide Semi-Conductor).

The?NPN transistors?forming arrays are useful for both: interfacing between low logic level digital circuitry and achieving the higher current/voltage requirements in a wide range of applications including printer hammers, lamps, relays, consumer and industrial applications.
The device shows open?collector outputs and freewheeling clamp diodes that turn out to be very handy for transient suppression.
Following figure shows the pinout of ULN2803. It comes with 8 input pins and 8 output pins.

Pin number from 1 to 8 is a Channel 1 through 8 Darlington base?input while pin number from 11 to 18 is?Channel 1 through 8 Darlington base output. Similarly, 9 and 10 pins are ground and common cathode node (Vcc) respectively. It is important to note that common emitter is shared by all the channels.
Following table shows the pin configuration of ULN2803.
Following figure shows the logic diagram of ULN2803. It is a visual representation and arrangement of how the diodes are connected in the component.
Following figure shows the schematic diagram of each Darlington pair.

You can see how the?resistors?and diodes are connected with each other. And the amplified output of one resistor is further amplified by the second resistor, giving a whopping amount of current gain which is difficult for the individual diode to achieve if incorporated separately.

These are the stress ratings which if exceed from absolute maximum ratings, can damage the device at large, ultimately affecting the overall nature and performance of the project.
Similarly, if these ratings are applied for the maximum period of time above normal operating conditions they can affect the reliability of the device.
Steps and measurements taken in the early stages of your project can save you from the atrocities of spending more in case the electronic circuit gets affected.
It is preferred to check these ratings before placing the device in the circuit and make sure these ratings are quite in line and match exactly as defined by the manufacturer.

makers-481490.summary: 30 W, 8.2 Ω cement power resistor ceramic core, silicon-cement sealed, welded tinned leads; rated for continuous 30 W with derating for high ambient.

blocks.text: The 30 W, 8.2 Ω cement-type power resistor is built around a high-alumina ceramic core and enclosed in a robust cement-coated ceramic case. The resistive element is available as either metal-oxide film or resistance wire, embedded and sealed with silicon resin (silicon cement) to provide mechanical protection and improved heat transfer. Termination is achieved with tinned iron end caps and welded, solderable leads, forming a compact, serviceable package suited for through-hole mounting or wired connections in power circuits.

Rated at 30 W, this resistor’s rated voltage equals √(P×R), which for 30 W × 8.2 Ω is approximately 15.68 V. It is designed for continuous operation at the rated ambient for its class, with a derating curve applied when ambient temperature exceeds the rated point. The part tolerates short-time overloads and pulsed stress within the limits defined by the spec (short-time overload, pulse overload cycles, and specified maximum pulse voltages), giving stable resistance under transient and steady-state thermal loading.

Engineered to meet standard JIS-based reliability tests, the resistor passes solderability and solder-heat resistance checks, dielectric and insulation tests, temperature cycling, humidity load-life, and extended load-life endurance at elevated temperature. Its silicon-cement sealing and ceramic case reduce moisture ingress and mechanical stress, minimizing long-term resistance drift and ensuring predictable performance in demanding industrial and power applications.

blocks.text: MG995 Servo Motor Tower Pro Continuous Rotation (Full Metal Gear)

The MG995 Tower Pro Continuous Rotation Servo Motor is a high-performance, durable servo designed for applications that require full 360-degree continuous motion. Unlike standard servo motors that rotate to a specific angle (e.g., 0° to 180°), this version of the MG995 is modified to provide continuous rotation, making it ideal for wheeled robots, conveyor systems, mobile platforms, and other projects requiring bidirectional speed control.

Equipped with full metal gears, including strong brass and steel components, the MG995 is built to handle mechanical stress and heavy loads without gear wear or failure. Its robust internal structure allows for higher torque output — up to 12 kg·cm at 6V — which is particularly beneficial for mobile robotics or lifting mechanisms. The inclusion of dual ball bearings enhances smooth motion and longevity, even under frequent or high-load usage.

This servo is controlled using a PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) signal, but instead of controlling position, the pulse length controls the speed and direction of rotation. A 1.5 ms pulse stops the motor, pulses shorter than 1.5 ms make it spin in one direction, and pulses longer than 1.5 ms make it spin in the opposite direction. The further the pulse deviates from 1.5 ms, the faster the motor spins.

The MG995 continuous rotation servo operates at a voltage range of 4.8V to 7.2V, with a typical operating speed of around 0.14–0.20 sec/60° equivalent, depending on voltage. Its standard 3-wire interface (orange for signal, red for VCC, and brown for GND) makes it easily compatible with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and RC controllers.
In summary, the MG995 Continuous Rotation Servo Motor is a powerful, reliable, and affordable solution for motion control in DIY robotics, smart automation, and RC-based projects.

The slow-blow feature of this fuse makes it ideal for applications involving inductive loads such as motors, transformers, or power supplies, where inrush currents are common. Typical applications for this fuse include home appliances, battery chargers, power adapters, audio systems, LED drivers, and industrial control equipment. It is widely preferred in situations where both current protection and tolerance to brief surges are necessary.

Built to meet the demands of precision applications, the LF411 provides a high gain-bandwidth product and a fast settling time. Its low power consumption and excellent thermal stability ensure longevity and reliable operation. With high common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR) and power supply rejection ratio (PSRR), the LF411 ensures that external noise and fluctuations have minimal impact on performance. The Microchip ATECC608B-TFLXTLS is the TrustFLEX secure element part of the Trust Platform for the CryptoAuthentication family. The device comes pre-configured implementing the most common authentication use cases use in the embedded industry by default. It will help the architect accelerating his development time. The configuration is locked in the device and cannot be changed. The cloud infrastructure, either it’s a public of private network, can implement either token-base authentication or customer certificate authentication (traditional PKI model). This secure element integrates ECDH (Elliptic Curve Diffie Hellman) security protocol an ultra-secure method to provide key agreement for encryption/decryption, along with ECDSA (Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm) sign-verify authentication for the Internet of Things (IoT) market including home automation, industrial networking, medical, retail or any TLS connected networks. Other important features integrated in the ATECC608B-TFLXTLS are the AES128 hardware accelerator and hardware-based cryptographic key storage and cryptographic countermeasures which eliminate potential backdoors linked to software weaknesses.

The device is agnostic of any microprocessor (MPU) or microcontroller (MCU) and compatible with virtually any MCUs or MPUs thanks to the CryptoAuthLib library. As with all CryptoAuthentication devices, the ATECCC608B-TFLXTLS delivers extremely low-power consumption, requires only a single GPIO over a wide voltage range, and has a tiny form factor making it ideal for a variety of applications that require longer battery life and flexible form factors.

The ATECC608B-TFLXTLS comes also provisioned with default thumbprint certificates and key that are unlocked in the device and changeable by the customer own credentials (differently than the ATECC608B Trust&GO). It helps providing the flexibility to the customer to implement its own certificate chain. Take a look at the various code examples using the Microchip Trust Platform software tool:
– Cloud authentication for AWS IoT (32-bit MCU)
– Cloud Authentication for AWS IoT Greengrass (Linux)
– Cloud Authentication for Microsoft Azure (32-bit MCU)
– TLS network authentication with third party stacks

تُعد وحدة قيادة المحرك الخطوي تي ام سي 2208 إصدار 1.2 من الحلول الممتازة للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى تشغيل هادئ، حركة ناعمة، وتحكم دقيق في المحركات الخطوية. وقد أصبحت هذه الوحدة من الخيارات الشائعة في الطابعات ثلاثية الأبعاد، وأنظمة التحكم الرقمي، والروبوتات، والمشاريع الإلكترونية المتقدمة بفضل أدائها المستقر وتقنيتها المصممة لتقليل الضوضاء أثناء التشغيل.

أهم ما يميز هذه الوحدة هو قدرتها على تشغيل المحرك بصوت منخفض جدًا مقارنة بالعديد من وحدات القيادة التقليدية، وهو ما يجعلها مناسبة جدًا للأنظمة التي يُفضل فيها تقليل الضوضاء وتحسين نعومة الحركة. لذلك فهي مناسبة بشكل خاص للأنظمة التي تعتمد على الحركة المستمرة والدقيقة وتحتاج إلى مستوى أفضل من الراحة والاستقرار أثناء العمل.

تدعم الوحدة طريقتين في الإعداد والتحكم، حيث يمكن استخدامها من خلال النبض والاتجاه في التوصيل التقليدي، أو من خلال الاتصال التسلسلي لإتاحة إعدادات وتحكم أكثر تقدمًا. كما تدعم دقة تقسيم عالية جدًا تصل إلى واحد على مئتين وستة وخمسين، مما يساعد على تحسين سلاسة الحركة وتقليل الاهتزاز وتحقيق أداء أكثر دقة.

تأتي الوحدة في تصميم مدمج مناسب للتركيب على اللوحات المتوافقة، كما يرفق معها مشتت حراري للمساعدة في تحسين التبريد، بالإضافة إلى مفك صغير لتسهيل الضبط أثناء التركيب والإعداد. وهذا يجعلها حلًا عمليًا للمستخدمين الذين يريدون ترقية أنظمتهم إلى مستوى أعلى من الهدوء والدقة.
إذا كنت تبحث عن درايفر محرك خطوي يوفر هدوءًا ملحوظًا، وتحكمًا أفضل، وحركة أكثر سلاسة، فإن هذه الوحدة تمثل اختيارًا مناسبًا لمجموعة كبيرة من التطبيقات التعليمية والاحترافية والهوايات التقنية.

blocks.text: The HT12D is a CMOS 12-bit decoder IC in an 18-pin PDIP package designed for remote control and data communication applications. It works in tandem with encoder ICs to decode serial data transmitted over RF or infrared links into parallel output signals. Featuring a 12-bit address and data format, this device provides robust address matching and reliable data recovery with minimal external components. The HT12D includes built-in oscillator requirements, data latch enable, and valid transmission indicators, making it suitable for use in security systems, garage door controls, wireless alarms, and other digital communication interfaces where simple and efficient decoding of remote inputs is required.

blocks.v: A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6 & A7 · These are the 8-bit address bits, which is used to protect your data. We should set the bits in same pattern on Encoder and Decoder IC to pair them.
Ground/Vss · Connected to the Ground of circuit
AD0, AD1, AD2 & AD3 · These four pins are used to obtain the data bits by decoding the data from HT12E IC
Input · The Encoded 12 bit output data obtained from HT12E has to be given here
Oscillator pins 1 & 2 · The IC has a built in oscillator. This oscillator can be used by connecting these two pins through a 1M Resistor
Valid Transmission (VT) · This pin will go high when a data is received. It is not mandatory to use it.
Vcc/Vdd · This pin powers the IC should use only 5V

blocks.text: Note: Complete Technical Details can be found at the HT12D datasheet given at the end of this page.
Where to use HT12D RF Decoder

The IC HT12D can be used only with its pair HT12E. These two ICs together form an Encoder and Decoder pair. They are 12-bit Encoders/Decoders, meaning they can transmit 12-bit data among them. But your encoder IC should not communicate with someone else’s decoder IC, so an Encoder and Decoder IC pair will share a common Address which is an 8-bit data. So out of the 12-bits 8-bits will be used to set address and the remaining 4-bit will be used to transmit data. With 4-bit data we can create 16 types (2^4 =16) of combinations. These IC’s are commonly used with RF pairs or IR pairs. So if you are working on a project which has to transmit a 4-bit data from one end to other either by wire or wireless then this IC pair will be best suited for you.
How to use a HT12D RF Decoder

The primary function of HT12D is to decode the 12-bit that is received by the input pin. Since the IC comes with an in-built Oscillator it is very easy to make this IC work. The IC is should be powered by 5V (pin 18) and the ground pin (pin 9) is grounded. For decoding a data the IC will requires an oscillator, luckily this IC has one in-built. We just have to connect the OSC1 and OSC2 (pin 15 & 16) through a 470K resistor to invoke it. The 4-bit data that is received can be obtained on pins AD0 to AD1 and an address of 8-bit has to be set using the pins A0 to A7. It is very important that your Decoder should have the same address of that of the encoder. A basic circuit diagram for the HT12D IC is shown below

In the above circuit I have set the 8-bit address data as 0b00000000, by connecting all address pins to ground. If you want security you can connect any of the 8 pins to 5V to make it high. The complete IC is powered by a +5V supply which could be obtained from a voltage regulator like 7805.The pins AD3, AD2, AD1 and AD0 are connected to any Digital IC that can read the 4-bit data. They can also be connected to LED to physically view the received data. In this the 4-bit output data is just shown as “?” since we do not know what the Encoder IC has sent to the Input pin. If any valid data is received they can be obtained from these four pins.

blocks.text: MaAnt Ant936 Series 900M Soldering Iron Tips – I / J / SK

MaAnt Ant936 Series 900M Soldering Iron Tips are universal replacement soldering iron heads designed for technicians, repair workshops, electronics labs, and micro-soldering applications. This variable product includes selected tip shapes from the Ant936 series, giving users the ability to choose the most suitable soldering head according to the repair task, soldering area, component size, and working angle.

The available variations are 900M-T-I, 900M-T-J, and 900M-T-SK. Each variation is designed for a different soldering style: the I tip is suitable for fine straight-point soldering, the J tip is suitable for curved precision soldering in narrow areas, and the SK knife-style tip is suitable for wider contact soldering, drag soldering, bridge correction, and more flexible repair work. This makes the product a practical choice for users who want one product page that covers multiple soldering tip options without creating separate listings for every shape.

The MaAnt Ant936 series is made with a red copper core for fast heat conduction and stable temperature response. The tip structure uses multilayer electroplating to improve surface durability, oxidation resistance, tin wetting behavior, and long service life. A built-in stainless steel pipe helps reduce the chance of the inner wall oxidizing and sticking to the heating core, making replacement easier and helping protect the soldering iron heater during maintenance.

These soldering tips are suitable for most 936-type soldering stations and soldering irons that use compatible 900M-style tips. They are commonly used for phone board repair, laptop motherboard maintenance, SMD component soldering, IC pin touch-up, jumper wire work, connector soldering, bridge cleaning, and general electronics repair.

سنون كاوية ما أنت فئة تسعمائة إم للحام والصيانة الدقيقة

سنون كاوية ما أنت من فئة أنت تسعمائة ستة وثلاثين هي سنون بديلة شاملة مصممة لأعمال الصيانة الإلكترونية، وورش إصلاح الهواتف، والمعامل، وأعمال اللحام الدقيق. المنتج هنا يتم إعداده كمنتج متعدد الاختيارات، بحيث يختار العميل شكل السن المناسب حسب نوع الصيانة، مساحة اللحام، حجم المكون، وزاوية الوصول إلى نقطة العمل.

المقاسات المتاحة لدينا هي: سن مستقيم رفيع، وسن منحني رفيع، وسن سكينة رفيع. كل شكل له استخدام عملي مختلف؛ السن المستقيم مناسب للنقاط الصغيرة جدًا وأرجل المكونات الدقيقة، والسن المنحني مناسب للوصول إلى الأماكن الضيقة والزوايا الصعبة، أما سن السكينة فهو مناسب للحام بالسحب، وإصلاح الجسور، والكونكتورات، والنقاط التي تحتاج مساحة تلامس أكبر مع القصدير.

تم تصميم هذه الفئة بلب من النحاس الأحمر للمساعدة في توصيل الحرارة بسرعة وثبات أثناء العمل. كما تعتمد على طبقات طلاء متعددة لتحسين مقاومة الأكسدة، وتحسين قابلية التقصدير، وزيادة العمر التشغيلي للسن عند الاستخدام الصحيح. وجود ماسورة داخلية من الاستانلس يساعد على تقليل التصاق السن بقلب التسخين، مما يجعل عملية تغيير السن أسهل ويقلل خطر تلف السخان أثناء الاستبدال.

blocks.text: RELIFE RL-440 20/80 Active Rosin Core Solder Wire 0.3mm 20g

RELIFE RL-440 20/80 Active Rosin Core Solder Wire 0.3mm 20g is a fine-diameter solder wire designed for electronics repair, mobile phone maintenance, circuit board work, and precision soldering tasks. With a 0.3mm wire diameter, this solder wire is especially useful when working on small pads, delicate tracks, compact electronic boards, and repair points that need accurate solder control.

The RELIFE RL-440 solder wire uses an active rosin core to improve wetting, solder spreading, and oxide film removal during soldering. This helps the solder flow more smoothly on clean solderable surfaces and supports brighter, more consistent solder joints. The 20/80 alloy ratio makes it a practical medium-temperature soldering wire for many repair and maintenance applications where controlled solder feeding is needed.

This spool has an approximate net weight of 20g, making it suitable for technicians, repair shops, electronics students, hobbyists, and workshop use. The compact reel is easy to store, carry, and use on the bench without taking much space. It is suitable for manual soldering with a temperature-controlled soldering iron and can be used for a wide range of electronics service tasks.

The 0.3mm diameter gives better control than thicker solder wire when soldering small components or working near fine pins. It helps reduce excess solder application and makes it easier to form clean solder joints in detailed repair work. For phone boards, small modules, sensors, connectors, repair jumpers, and electronic components, this wire gives the user better handling and more precise solder delivery.

سلك قصدير ريلايف النشط بالروزن قطر ٠.٣ مللي وزن ٢٠ جرام هو سلك لحام دقيق مخصص لأعمال إصلاح الإلكترونيات وصيانة لوحات الهواتف والدوائر الإلكترونية الدقيقة. القطر الرفيع ٠.٣ مللي يجعله مناسبًا جدًا للأماكن الصغيرة ونقاط اللحام الدقيقة التي تحتاج إلى تحكم أفضل في كمية القصدير أثناء العمل.

يحتوي السلك على قلب نشط من الروزن يساعد على تحسين انتشار القصدير وإزالة طبقة الأكسدة من سطح اللحام، مما يساعد على تكوين نقطة لحام أنظف وأكثر ثباتًا عند استخدامه بطريقة صحيحة. كما أن نسبة ٢٠ على ٨٠ تجعله مناسبًا لأعمال الصيانة المتوسطة التي تحتاج إلى تدفق جيد وتحكم عملي أثناء اللحام.

وزن البكرة حوالي ٢٠ جرام، وهو حجم عملي مناسب للفنيين ومراكز الصيانة والهواة وطلاب الإلكترونيات. البكرة صغيرة وسهلة التخزين والاستخدام على ترابيزة الصيانة، ولا تحتاج إلى مساحة كبيرة داخل شنطة الأدوات أو درج الورشة.

يساعد قطر السلك الرفيع على تقليل كمية القصدير الزائدة عند لحام الأرجل الصغيرة أو نقاط التوصيل القريبة من بعضها، مما يقلل احتمالية حدوث تلامس غير مرغوب بين المسارات أو الأرجل. لذلك يعتبر اختيارًا مناسبًا لصيانة الهواتف، الوحدات الإلكترونية، الحساسات، الموصلات، الكروت الصغيرة، وأعمال اللحام التي تحتاج إلى دقة وتحكم.

blocks.text: Telijia TE-12 Precision Opening Tool Set for Electronic Device Repair

طقم فتح دقيق لصيانة الموبايلات والأجهزة الإلكترونية

طقم الفتح الدقيق تيليجيا تي إي اثنا عشر هو طقم يدوي عملي مخصص لفك وفتح الأجهزة الإلكترونية الصغيرة، ويُستخدم بشكل أساسي في صيانة الموبايلات، فتح أغطية الأجهزة، المساعدة في فصل الشاشات، التعامل مع العلب البلاستيكية، وأعمال الصيانة التي تحتاج إلى أداة رفيعة لا تسبب خدوشًا قوية عند الاستخدام الصحيح.

الطقم مناسب لفنيي الصيانة، مراكز إصلاح الموبايلات، هواة الإلكترونيات، والطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى أداة بسيطة ومفيدة داخل شنطة الصيانة أو على ترابيزة العمل. يتميز التصميم بالحجم الصغير واللون الأسود العملي، مع وجود أداة فتح رئيسية وعدة قطع دائرية مساعدة للاستخدام حسب طبيعة الجهاز أو الغطاء المطلوب فتحه.

هذا المنتج يساعد في تقليل احتمالية كسر الكلبسات البلاستيكية أو خدش الأطراف عند فتح الأجهزة، بشرط استخدامه بهدوء وبدون ضغط زائد. في الأجهزة التي تحتوي على لاصق قوي، يفضل استخدام حرارة مناسبة قبل محاولة الفتح لتقليل الضغط على الشاشة أو الغطاء أو الإطار.

blocks.text: DY50 Fingerprint Reader Sensor Optical Fingerprint Module for Arduino

The DY50 Fingerprint Reader Sensor Optical Fingerprint Module for Arduino is a practical biometric security solution for makers, developers, and embedded system designers who need dependable fingerprint-based access control. This optical fingerprint module captures, stores, and compares fingerprint data with fast response time, making it suitable for projects that require secure user authentication without relying on keys, cards, or passwords.

This module is designed to communicate easily with microcontrollers through a UART TTL interface, which makes it highly compatible with Arduino, custom controller boards, and many other embedded systems. It can operate from 3.6V to 6.0V, allowing flexible integration in both 3.3V and 5V logic-based projects, while maintaining stable performance and relatively low current consumption.

The DY50 offers solid biometric performance with support for 1:1 matching mode and 1:N search mode, enabling it to work in both direct verification and multi-user identification systems. It stores up to 200 fingerprint templates according to the provided product data, and the vendor documentation also references internal template storage with signature and template file handling for secure fingerprint processing. The module is built for fast operation, with fingerprint image acquisition and search times typically below 1 second, which helps create responsive and user-friendly access systems.

For security-focused projects, the sensor provides a False Accept Rate below 0.001% and a False Reject Rate below 1.0% at security level 3, helping improve trust in access control applications. The optical sensing area is designed for accurate fingerprint capture, with a window size of 14 × 18 mm, making finger placement practical for daily use in smart locks, attendance terminals, storage cabinets, time logging devices, and electronic authorization systems.

The module is especially suitable for applications where compact size, onboard memory, UART connectivity, and biometric authentication are required in one integrated unit. Whether you are building a secure door lock system, a fingerprint-based attendance device, a garage access project, or a microcontroller authentication system, the DY50 provides a compact and effective identification platform. Cirkit Designer documentation also shows it commonly used in Arduino-based authentication systems and access-control projects.

تُعد وحدة قارئ البصمة دي واي 50 البصرية للأردوينو حلًا عمليًا وفعالًا لإضافة التحقق البيومتري إلى المشاريع الإلكترونية وأنظمة الأمان المدمجة. تعتمد هذه الوحدة على قراءة بصمة الإصبع بصريًا ثم تخزينها ومقارنتها بسرعة، مما يجعلها مناسبة للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى وسيلة تعريف آمنة بدلًا من المفاتيح التقليدية أو كلمات المرور أو البطاقات.

تتميز الوحدة بسهولة التوصيل مع المتحكمات الدقيقة من خلال واجهة يوارت بمستوى تي تي إل، وهو ما يجعل دمجها مع الأردوينو ولوحات التحكم المختلفة أمرًا مباشرًا في كثير من التطبيقات. كما أنها تعمل ضمن نطاق جهد من 3.6 فولت إلى 6 فولت، وهو نطاق مناسب للعديد من الدوائر الإلكترونية الشائعة سواء في المشاريع التعليمية أو النظم الاحترافية.

تدعم هذه الوحدة وضعي تشغيل مهمين، هما المقارنة المباشرة واحد إلى واحد والبحث داخل قاعدة بيانات واحد إلى عدة مستخدمين، مما يسمح باستخدامها في أنظمة تحقق فردية أو أنظمة دخول متعددة المستخدمين. وبحسب البيانات المرسلة، يمكنها تخزين حتى 200 بصمة، مع ملفات توقيع وقوالب مخصصة لمعالجة بيانات البصمات. كما أن زمن التقاط الصورة وزمن البحث أقل من ثانية واحدة تقريبًا، وهو ما يساعد على تقديم تجربة استخدام سريعة ومريحة.

ومن الناحية الأمنية، توفر الوحدة معدل قبول خاطئ أقل من 0.001% ومعدل رفض خاطئ أقل من 1.0% عند مستوى الأمان الثالث، وهو ما يمنحها دقة جيدة في أنظمة التحكم في الدخول والتشغيل المشروط. كما أن نافذة قراءة البصمة بحجم 14 × 18 مم تمنح مساحة مناسبة لوضع الإصبع بشكل مريح أثناء الاستخدام اليومي في الأقفال الذكية وأجهزة الحضور والخزائن الإلكترونية ومشروعات التحكم الآمن.

blocks.text: XT60 Male and Female Connector with 10cm 16AWG Silicone Wire

This set includes one XT60 male connector and one XT60 female connector, each pre-attached to high-quality 16AWG silicone wire with a length of 10cm, making it suitable for a wide range of power wiring tasks.

XT60 connectors are widely used in battery systems, chargers, RC models, drones, robotics projects, portable power setups, and many DIY electronics applications because of their dependable connection quality and durable mechanical design. Their tight-fit structure helps reduce the chance of accidental disconnection, while also supporting stable current flow in demanding power applications.

تُستخدم وصلات XT60 بشكل واسع في توصيلات البطاريات، وأعمال الشحن، وأنظمة الطاقة المحمولة، ومشروعات الطائرات والدرونز، والروبوتات، والتطبيقات الإلكترونية التي تحتاج إلى وصلة قوية وآمنة لنقل الطاقة. كما أن تصميمها العملي يساعد على توفير اتصال محكم يقلل من فرص الانفصال غير المقصود أثناء التشغيل أو الحركة.

The Aluminum Water Cooling Block 40×160mm is a practical and efficient liquid-cooling solution for applications that require stable thermal management in a compact rectangular format. Acting as the liquid-cooling equivalent of a traditional heat sink, this water block is designed to absorb heat from a mounted source and transfer it into the flowing coolant inside the internal channels.

Manufactured from heavy aluminum, this cooling block offers a good balance between thermal performance, strength, and lightweight construction. The internal flow path is formed to help improve heat exchange efficiency by increasing the coolant contact path inside the block. This makes it suitable for electronics cooling systems, industrial thermal control, and custom liquid-cooling projects.

With its 40mm width and 160mm length, this model provides a larger surface area than smaller cooling blocks, making it useful for applications that require wider heat distribution or cooling for longer modules and assemblies. It can be used in computer CPU and GPU water cooling, Peltier cooling systems, laser head cooling, industrial inverter driver cooling, power electronics, and industrial control cabinet thermal management.

This type of cooling plate is especially useful in systems where air cooling may not be enough, or where quieter and more efficient heat removal is needed. When integrated into a proper closed-loop water cooling system, it helps improve thermal stability and can support better long-term operating conditions for heat-generating components.

blocks.text: 12x12x7.3mm 4 Pin Tactile Push Button Switch – Through-Hole Momentary Square Key

The 12x12x7.3mm 4 Pin Tactile Push Button Switch is a dependable momentary push switch widely used in electronic projects as a standard input button. It is designed for applications that require a compact, responsive, and durable switch for manual user control. With its through-hole mounting design, this switch is especially suitable for direct PCB installation and can also be used in prototype setups during testing and development.

This tactile switch features a 4-pin configuration and a square actuator shaft, offering a stable mechanical structure and convenient integration into a wide range of electronic designs. The switch operates with a momentary push-to-on function, meaning the contacts remain normally open and close only while the button is pressed. This makes it an excellent choice for reset buttons, menu buttons, user input keys, control interfaces, and temporary signal triggering in many devices.

One of the key advantages of this switch is its strong tactile response, which gives the user a clear and precise pressing feel. Its design supports a relatively high operating force, making it suitable for applications where a firmer press is preferred. Despite that, it still delivers smooth and accurate operation with a middle stroke of 1.05mm, helping improve user control and repeatability.

The switch is also built for long-term performance, with a mechanical and electrical life of up to 300,000 cycles, making it a practical option for products that require frequent use. Its compact size of 12mm × 12mm × 7.3mm allows easy use in dense circuit layouts without occupying excessive space.

This push button switch is commonly used in consumer electronics, telecommunications devices, test equipment, industrial controls, medical devices, home appliances, audio systems, and computer peripherals. It also works very well in educational electronics, Arduino-compatible control projects, repair tasks, and general circuit design applications.

The contacts are designed to provide good electrical conductivity, low contact resistance, and stable signal transmission. Its compact body, lightweight structure, and easy mounting style make it an efficient component for both professional and hobby electronics work.

blocks.text: IIC/I2C Serial Interface Adapter Module pcf8574 HW-061

This is a RoHS compliant I2C Serial LCD Daughter board that can be connected to a standard 16×2 or 20×4 Character Display Module that supports 4-bit mode. All Character Modules sold on our site support 4-bit mode, and nearly all commercially available 16×2 and 20×4 line character modules support it too.

This board has a PCF8574 I2C chip that converts I2C serial data to parallel data for the LCD display. There are many examples on the internet for using this board with Arduino. Do a search for “Arduino LCD PCF8574“. The I2C address is 0x3F by default, but this can be changed via 3 solder jumpers provided on the board. This allows up to 3 LCD displays to be controlled via a single I2C bus (giving each one it’s own address)

blocks.text: The FQPF15N60 (often referred to as 15N60) is a high-voltage N-Channel Power MOSFET engineered for power conversion and switching applications that demand strong voltage margin and reliable current handling. With a 600V drain-source rating (VDS) and 15A continuous drain current (ID), it is commonly used in high-voltage switching stages where efficiency and thermal stability are critical.

This MOSFET helps improve converter efficiency thanks to its low on-state resistance, with RDS(on) up to 0.5Ω, reducing conduction losses compared to many standard high-voltage devices in similar classes. It is also designed for robust thermal operation, offering high power dissipation capability up to 312W (with appropriate heatsinking and thermal conditions) and a maximum junction temperature of 150°C, which supports dependable operation in industrial and power-supply environments.

For switching performance, the FQPF15N60 has a gate threshold voltage up to 4V (VGS(th)), a total gate charge (Qg) of 270nC, and rise time up to 200ns. These parameters should be considered when selecting a gate driver and switching frequency, especially in higher-power SMPS or inverter designs. The output capacitance (Coss) is 270pF, which also influences switching losses and EMI behavior in fast-switching topologies.
Strong thermal capability: PD up to 312W (with proper cooling)

Suitable for high-voltage switching & power conversion

موسفت قدرة قناة إن 600 فولت 15 أمبير (FQPF15N60)

إف كيو بي إف 15 إن 60 (FQPF15N60) المعروف أيضًا باسم 15N60 هو موسفت قدرة بقناة إن مخصص لتطبيقات التبديل والتحويل عالي الجهد في إلكترونيات القدرة. يتحمل جهدًا حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر، مع تيار مستمر حتى 15 أمبير، لذلك يُستخدم بكثرة في مراحل القدرة التي تتطلب كفاءة عالية واعتمادية وثباتًا حراريًا جيدًا.

يساعد هذا الموسفت على تقليل الفقد أثناء التوصيل بفضل مقاومة توصيل منخفضة حيث تصل مقاومة التوصيل حتى 0.5 أوم كحد أقصى، وهو ما يساهم في رفع كفاءة دوائر التحويل. كما يدعم التشغيل القاسي حراريًا بفضل قدرة تبديد عالية تصل إلى 312 وات عند توفير تبريد مناسب، بالإضافة إلى أقصى حرارة للوصلة 150 درجة مئوية، مما يجعله مناسبًا للبيئات الصناعية ومزودات الطاقة عالية الجهد.

من ناحية التبديل، يصل جهد عتبة البوابة إلى 4 فولت كحد أقصى، وتبلغ شحنة البوابة الكلية 270 نانوكولوم، ويصل زمن الصعود إلى 200 نانوثانية. هذه القيم مهمة عند اختيار درايفر البوابة وتحديد تردد التبديل. كما أن سعة الخرج 270 بيكوفاراد تؤثر على الفقد أثناء التبديل وعلى التداخل الكهرومغناطيسي في الدوائر السريعة.

blocks.text: ESP8266 ESP‑01 12V 2‑Channel Wi‑Fi Relay Module (Dual Buttons) | وحدة تتابع واي فاي 12 فولت قناتان (زرّان)

The ESP8266 ESP‑01 12V 2‑Channel Wi‑Fi Relay Module combines an ESP‑01 (ESP8266) Wi‑Fi card with a stable STM8S103 MCU to deliver wireless control of two independent 10A relays. It supports two operating modes—Mode 1 (AP/direct) and Mode 2 (STA/router)—with dual buttons (S1 mode toggle, S2 factory reset), clear LED indicators for mode, status, and each relay, and screw terminals labeled COM1/NO1/NC1 and COM2/NO2/NC2. For makers and integrators, the board exposes UART TX/RX for ESP debugging and SWIM/NRST pads for the STM8. Typical direct AP range is ~100 m in open air; in router mode range depends on AP signal (some listings quote up to 400 m line‑of‑sight). Each relay is a SRD‑12VDC‑SL‑C rated 10A @ 250VAC or 10A @ 30VDC.

تجمع وحدة ريلاي واي فاي 12 فولت بقناتين ESP‑01 (ESP8266) بين بطاقة الواي فاي ESP‑01 ومتحكّم STM8S103 لتوفير تحكم لاسلكي في ريلايين مستقلين 10A. تدعم وضعين للتشغيل—الوضع 1 (AP مباشر) والوضع 2 (STA عبر الراوتر)—مع زرّين (S1 لتبديل الوضع، S2 لإرجاع المصنع)، ومؤشرات LED واضحة لحالة الوضع والاتصال ولكل ريلاي، وأطراف لولبية موسومة COM1/NO1/NC1 وCOM2/NO2/NC2. للمطورين، توفّر اللوحة TX/RX لتصحيح ESP ووسادات SWIM/NRST لبرمجة STM8. يبلغ المدى عادةً ~100 م في الهواء الطلق بوضع AP؛ وفي وضع الراوتر يعتمد على إشارة نقطة الوصول (وتذكر بعض القوائم حدًا أقصى 400 م في خط نظر). كل ريلاي من نوع SRD‑12VDC‑SL‑C بمعدل 10A عند 250VAC أو 30VDC.
📶 ESP8266 Wi‑Fi + STM8 MCU for reliable wireless control.
🔌 Dual 10A relays (SRD‑12VDC‑SL‑C) for AC mains or DC loads.
🗂️ Two operating modes: AP/direct and STA/router.
🧭 Two buttons: S1 mode select; S2 factory reset.
💡 LED map: D7 (Mode 1/AP), D5 (Mode 2/STA), D6 (status heartbeat), D2 & D4 (relay ON indicators).
🧪 Developer access: UART TX/RX, SWIM/NRST pads; jumper caps to route serial.
🔁 Hex UART commands for Relay 1 & 2 control.
🔋 12V DC input via IN+ / IN‑ terminal; on‑board 5V regulation for logic.
📶 واي فاي ESP8266 + متحكّم STM8 لتحكم لاسلكي موثوق.

🧭 زرّان: S1 لاختيار الوضع؛ S2 لإرجاع المصنع.
💡 خريطة LED: D7 لوضع 1، D5 لوضع 2، D6 حالة، D2 وD4 حالة تشغيل الريلايات.
🧪 وصول المطور: TX/RX، ووسادات SWIM/NRST؛ وجمبرز لتوجيه التسلسلي.
🔁 أوامر هيكس UART للتحكم في الريلاي 1 و2.
🔋 دخل 12V DC عبر IN+/IN‑ مع تنظيم 5V على اللوحة.
LEDs — D7 red (Mode 1), D5 blue (Mode 2), D6 green (status), D2 (Relay1 ON), D4 (Relay2 ON).
Jumpers — keep RX↔RX1 and TX↔TX1 in bottom position for normal use; move to top to route ESP‑01 UART for external USB‑to‑TTL debugging.
مقبس ESP‑01 — وحدة واي فاي قابلة للفك.
S2 — استعادة ضبط المصنع (مسح بيانات الشبكة).
LED — D7 أحمر (وضع 1)، D5 أزرق (وضع 2)، D6 أخضر (حالة)، D2 (ريلاي 1)، D4 (ريلاي 2).
الجمبرز — في الوضع الطبيعي اجعل RX مع RX1 وTX مع TX1 في الأسفل؛ وانقلها للأعلى لتوجيه تسلسلي ESP‑01 لتصحيح خارجي.
Mode 1 (AP/Direct) — Phone connects directly to the module’s AP; ideal for bench tests or isolated control. Up to ~100 m typical in open space.
Mode 2 (STA/Router) — Phone and module join the same router. Range and stability depend on AP signal; some vendors quote up to 400 m LOS.
الوضع 1 (AP مباشر) — يتصل الهاتف مباشرة بنقطة الوصول الخاصة بالوحدة؛ مناسب للاختبارات أو التحكم المعزول. المدى المعتاد ~100 م في مكان مفتوح.
الوضع 2 (STA/راوتر) — ينضم الهاتف والوحدة للراوتر نفسه. يعتمد المدى على إشارة الراوتر؛ وتذكر بعض القوائم حتى 400 م بخط نظر.
LED Status Map | خريطة مصابيح البيان
D6 Green (status): Off → self‑configuring or router lost; Blink 0.5s → waiting for APP SmartConfig; Slow blink 2s → credentials stored, awaiting TCP link; Solid → TCP link established.
D2 Red → Relay 1 ON; D4 Red → Relay 2 ON.
D6 أخضر (حالة): مطفأ → إعداد ذاتي أو فقد راوتر؛ وميض 0.5ث → انتظار SmartConfig؛ وميض 2ث بطيء → تم الحفظ وبانتظار اتصال TCP؛ ثابت → تم الاتصال.
D2 أحمر → ريلاي 1 يعمل؛ D4 أحمر → ريلاي 2 يعمل.
COM1/NO1/NC1 control Relay 1; COM2/NO2/NC2 control Relay 2.
NO closes to COM when the relay turns ON (use for normal activation). NC opens when the relay turns ON (use for fail‑safe logic).
Use proper wire gauge, isolation, and enclosures for mains.
NO يغلق مع COM عند تشغيل الريلاي (تفعيل طبيعي). NC ينفتح عند التشغيل (منطق آمن).
استخدم مقطع سلك مناسبًا وعزلًا وصندوقًا للحماية مع التيار المتردد.
Supply: 12V DC on IN+ / IN‑; allow ≥ 1A headroom for relay coil and Wi‑Fi peaks.
UART: TX/RX for ESP‑01 (typical baud 9600 or 115200; verify).
STM8 programming: GND, SWIM, NRST pads + 5V reference header.
التغذية: 12 فولت عبر IN+/IN‑؛ يُفضَّل سعة ≥ 1A لهوامش الذروة.
التسلسلي: TX/RX لوحدة ESP‑01 (سرعة شائعة 9600 أو 115200؛ تحقّق).
برمجة STM8: وسادات GND, SWIM, NRST مع مرجع 5V.
Use ESP‑Touch / SmartConfig app to provision SSID/password in Mode 2. Phone must be on 2.4 GHz.
For manual TCP control, apps like Easy TCP – 20 let you store hex commands as buttons.
Status flow: D6 fast blink → slow blink → solid once TCP link is up.
استخدم تطبيق ESP‑Touch / SmartConfig لتهيئة اسم الشبكة وكلمة المرور في الوضع 2. يجب أن يكون الهاتف على 2.4 غيغاهرتز.

blocks.text: This module detects nearby objects with an infrared LED and a matching receiver. An LM393 comparator turns the reflected signal into a clean digital output, and a trimmer sets the detection distance. It is the usual choice for robot cars, line-side obstacle detection and simple counters.
Detection distance adjustable with the on-board trimmer (about 2–30 cm)
Digital output: LOW when an object is detected (active LOW)
Indicator LED lights when an obstacle is seen
Sunlight and strong lamps contain infrared and can cause false detections.
Dark or matte objects reflect less and are detected at a shorter distance than white ones.
The module detects the presence of an object; it does not measure distance – use the HC-SR04 for that.
HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor · female-to-female jumper wires
Why does it trigger in the sun?
Sunlight contains infrared; shield the sensor or use it indoors.
How do I change the range?
Turn the trimmer on the board while watching the indicator LED.
